extDescription.message: Automatically opens PDFs in the Gemini-compatible HTTPS PDF reader.

openFailed.message: Could not open the current tab as a PDF.

fileAccessHint.message: For local PDFs, enable “Allow access to file URLs” in Chrome’s extension details.

optionsIntro.message: The extension only handles PDF detection and local byte transfer. The reader itself remains a normal HTTP(S) page.

readerUrlDetail.message: The HTTP(S) page that renders your PDFs.

autoLocalLongDetail.message: Takes over PDFs opened from Finder or file:// URLs.

autoWebLongDetail.message: Optional. Opens PDF links on websites in the reader.

invalidUrl.message: Enter a valid HTTP(S) reader URL.

fileAccessOff.message: Local file access is currently disabled.

fileAccessHelp.message: Chrome controls local-file access separately. Open chrome://extensions, choose this extension’s Details, then turn on “Allow access to file URLs”.
